"""Build all-case tables and fixed native comparisons after actual quality review."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V172-local-noise-matching-v1'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
assert read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');audit=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')
summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V169-EMA','V171-EMA','V172-raw','V172-EMA'];columns=['V143 parent','V169 EMA','V171 EMA','V172 raw','V172 EMA']
text='# V172 local noise matching: completed quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v172-local-noise-matching-final-v1.json) · [Native pixels, source ROIs, checkpoint, noise and display metadata](images/v172-local-noise-matching-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside detail',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native 512-pixel standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Signed template gain 1 means exact constructed mesh amplitude; a small signed absent mean does not certify absence of artifacts. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. All paired differences and decrease/increase counts are retained. The reused, adaptively studied cohort does not establish blind generalization or training-seed uncertainty.\n\n'
text+='## Local units and matched training\n\n'
text+='The new transform centers parent RGB on each 2×2 Bayer-cell mean, which is also supplied. The quartet\'s mean physical variance defines its noise RMS and 16-DN16 input-unit floor. RAW innovations, variance ratios and level coordinates use these local units. The cell noise RMS scales its native RGB correction. All 39 coordinates remain. No image-wide mean/noise statistic enters this transform; the frozen V169/DINO result and matching network still use spatial context. The unit is an amplitude convention, not calibrated post-demosaic RGB covariance.\n\n'
text+='The 2,088,906 parameters/141 tensors, seeded initial state, frozen V169 EMA, V168 1,000-row cache, pair units, V171 criterion, AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA and schedule match V171. Preparation verifies the training/runtime/resource/restoration ASTs, criterion bytes and recipe fields. Only input coordinates and output amplitude change together; their individual effects are not isolated. The unchanged criterion still uses image-wide pixel/gradient units. No released V170 weights are loaded, and all 95 prior neural sources remain unchanged.\n\n'
text+='The matching core retains the [pinned NLFeMF definitions](https://github.com/MIA-UIB/nonlocal-matchfilter), width 16, nine neighbors per scale and three scales. A zero RGB tail gives exact initial V169 output. Zero supplied local variance retains V169 at that cell, including signed zero; wholly ADC-only rows bypass matching. Targets, clean masks and pairs enter only the unchanged training loss. This is not a noisy-flat guarantee or whole-pipeline locality claim.\n\n'
text+='The fixed cache contains 341 mesh, 243 photo, 156 mixed, 153 flat and 107 weak-detail rows, including V168\'s fine-wire/contrast ladder. The criterion combines pixel/gradient reconstruction, paired differences/common error, clean-flat anchoring and local/DC regret. It is byte-identical to V171. Original captures/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded; no source/noise draws, original/dataz reads or new parent/DINO calls occur.\n\n'
text+=f"The schedule completes {execution['actual_training_optimizer_updates']} optimizer updates and {execution['training_ADC_skips']} ADC-only skips, totaling 3,600 training images. A real step-8 checkpoint restores model, Adam, EMA and RNG state exactly, then continues at step 9 without prefix replay. All 141 trainable tensors receive nonzero gradients during training; 141 final Adam states and both endpoint tensors are finite and strictly checked. The sampler\'s unchanged CUDA input-gradient is atomic and warns under warn-only deterministic mode; exact restoration does not imply bit-exact retraining.\n\n"
text+='All 126 relevant CPU tests pass, including 12 new checks of independent NumPy cell statistics, four CFAs, native phase output units, zero/signed-zero routing, uniform-field equivalence, feature locality and identical initial tensors. New synthetic admission uses three batch-4 native 512 backward calls and one native 768 inference. Unchanged primitive/core sources inherit V171\'s independent CPU/CUDA adjoint and parity evidence; those old calls are not repeated or counted as new work. The frozen metric runtime is constructed successfully without CUDA before training launch.\n\n'
text+='A current-preparer style correction adds explicit `check=False` and parentheses around its probe string after freezing. Its training/review/runtime/model functions are unchanged, and both source versions are bound. [Original protocol](results/v172-local-noise-matching-v1/original-protocol-v1.md) · [Prepared sources](results/v172-local-noise-matching-preparation-v1.json) · [CPU and runtime readiness](results/v172-CPU-runtime-readiness-v1.json).\n\n'
training_audit=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"All 1,000 training input/parent/unit bindings and durable rows are audited. NumPy FP32 independently checks {training_audit['FP32_loss_totals_checked']} actual weighted loss totals. Clean-mask fingerprints reproduce V168\'s previously independently audited masks on identical targets; this is inheritance validation, not a fresh mask construction. Both raw/EMA states load strictly in the training and quality audits.\n\n"
text+=f"Quality completes 1,644 composed calls, each with frozen V169 evaluation; matching runs 1,500 times with 7,500 nested sampling forwards. All 1,644 V169 outputs replay their existing fingerprints exactly. All 144 ADC final outputs retain V169 exactly. V171 comparisons use its previously audited scores on the identical cached design, not new V171 inference. All 6,576 actual input fingerprints, durable rows and event bindings are checked. Independent in-process FP32 addition covers {audit['allcase_inprocess_addition_channels']:,} channels.\n\n"
text+=f"Full new arrays cover only 36 preselected native cases: 72 RGB plus 72 residuals, totaling 430,196,736 bytes. Independent posthoc metrics/addition cover those arrays, {audit['scalar_checks']} scalar values and {audit['independent_native_addition_channels']:,} RGB channels. Other outputs were scored/fingerprinted and independently norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but not retained. No complete new full-array archive or all-822 new-array posthoc audit is claimed. Decimal arithmetic checks {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} grouped means. The adaptively reused cohort does not establish blind generalization or training-seed uncertainty.\n\n"
text+=f"New matching work totals {execution['total_new_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} CUDA calls and no new CPU matching-core calls. Frozen-component CUDA calls total {execution['total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls']:,}; they are nested components, not DINO-parent calls. New admission adds four CUDA composed calls/13 images and three discarded synthetic updates; inherited primitive checks are not counted again. All three recorded owners are terminal, with no failed scientific phase or repeated prefix. Training/quality CUDA peaks are {execution['peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f}/{execution['peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f} GiB. There is no new full-frame/100MP or ten-second claim.\n\n"
text+='The bounded trial reserves 52/114 GiB local/external plus a 0.5 GiB projection margin, 32 GiB runtime RAM and 24 GiB CUDA, with 52 GiB launch RAM. Older guards and receipt bytes remain unchanged. Existing MIT and embedded sampler Caffe notices remain in provenance.\n\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='All 60 figures were actually viewed in 15 original-detail sheets: 48 boards and 12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets. Every cell is 160×160 native pixels without resizing. Sources/ROIs, checkpoint hashes, noisy-input conditioning, display exposure, camera transform, contrast and anchor are in the manifest. Mesh uses RGGB 512, ROI `[176,176,160,160]`, shot 0.00128/read variance 6.5536e-6, exposure 8 and contrast 1/40. Quiet fields use ROI `[80,176,160,160]`, exposure 8 and contrast 40; flats use ROI `[176,176,160,160]`, exposure 4 and contrast 40. ISO12800 uses shot 0.00256/read variance 2.62144e-5. Photographic credits/licenses remain in the [V168 source report](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n'
text+='Main DSCF3879 ISO6400/DSCF3880 ISO100 includes sky, building, foliage and coarse fence at exposure 4. Cab DSCF3842/3835 includes both priors, both windows `[206,229,160,160]`/`[426,189,160,160]` in 768-pixel contexts, exposure 16, and both camera JPEGs. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture, shutter, motion and processing; they are qualitative references, not exact GT, and are not pixelwise scored. Originals remain read-only and scene families excluded from training. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).\n\n'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v172-local-noise-matching-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v172-local-noise-matching-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
report=repo/'docs/local-noise-matching.md';report.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-completed-audits-and-actual-native-notes',report=ref(report),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built',len(cells),'metric cells;60 native figures')
